review_type: Model visual inspection; not clinical adjudication or patient identification
finding: No copied image established in the 20 highest-ranked previews. The leading pair is unusually similar and remains unresolved as possibly related acquisitions. This does not verify patient independence.

leading_pair.assessment: Unresolved possible related acquisitions; copied same image not established. Visible diaphragm, gas pattern and positioning differences persist at full resolution. Do not infer shared patient identity from similarity.

after_registration.note: Registration is diagnostic evidence only; it cannot establish a shared patient or duplicate acquisition.

other_reviewed_pairs.assessment: Copied images not established. Visible differences in anatomy, position, clothing or accessories in the contact sheets. This is not evidence of different patient identities.

limits: Screened only the initial cross-split dHash candidates.
Only 822 pairs received expensive feature checks and only the top 20 received visual inspection.
Large transformations can evade cheap correlation or the initial dHash search.
Source IDs are image-instance IDs, not patient IDs; source-ID separation cannot prove patient separation.
No source images, labels, annotations or splits were changed.
